parameters.help_en:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

`serious`: high

`suspicious`: medium

`remind`: low
parameters.help_zh:
威胁等级，格式为json数组。取值：
serious：高危。
suspicious：中危。
remind：低危
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account that is associated with the alert
parameters.name: sub_user_id

parameters.help_en: The data source of the alert
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the attack is defended. Valid values:

`0`: detected

`1`: blocked
parameters.help_zh:
是否已防御。取值：

0：检出
1：拦截
parameters.name: is_defend

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The entity of the alert. Valid values:

`0`: the current Alibaba Cloud account.

`1`: all members in the resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member in the resource directory
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the data management center of Threat Analysis resides. You can determine the region based on the region in which your assets reside. Valid values:

`cn-hangzhou`: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

`ap-southeast-1`: Your assets reside in regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
